question: Does keeping each public action connection pattern paired with its already-paid feedback improve estimation of next-batch net gain beyond independent feedback aggregation?
context: All already-paid same-station feedback, including flagged invalid/terminal rows. No truncation, reward-based topK or prototype selection.

action_descriptor.canonical_partition17: First active terminal anchors canonical bus0, other bus1; preserves complete two-bus partition.
action_descriptor.relative_partition17: Canonical bits minus canonical incumbent bits.
action_descriptor.active17: Connected status flag, distinguishes disconnected from canonical0.
action_descriptor.limitations: Public local terminal order kept. Invariant to bus1/2 swap and context-row permutation, not to arbitrary terminal permutations. Same118-station grid only; max17 derives from public static grid, not labels. No cross-grid transfer claim.

feedback_descriptor.reward: asinh((float32 reward-current incumbent float32 reward)/old gain_scale), no hard clipping. Nonfinite reward=>0 with missing flag.
feedback_descriptor.prohibited: No unbought outcomes, future reward, after_id, full-week cost, date or IDs as scalar predictors.

shared_inputs: Frozen normalized41 summary, encoded incumbent partition, known next-batch query cost(old price/scale); latter is an existing-information deterministic transform.

network.hidden_activation: ReLU after every hidden linear, including both encoder layers; head final2 linear.
network.factor: m_F=masked_mean_i F(feedback_i); v_i=V([A(action_i),m_F]). Same weights/shapes, but feedback pooled before associating with actions.
network.attention: q_j=Q(A(next_j));k_i=K(A(context_i)), each16->8 without bias; alpha_ji=masked_softmax(q_j dot k_i/sqrt8); r_j=sum alpha_ji v_i.
network.masks: Exclude padded context logits and next rows before mean/max. No empty context or next set enters gate.
network.interpretation: Attention averages learned latent vectors, not raw rewards. Linear value head can exceed observed-reward-derived values; no calibrated uncertainty or optimal extrapolation guarantee.

primary_comparison.matching: Exact same named parameter tensors/initial seed/Adam/state index stream/targets/update budget per seed. Only F aggregation location differs. This isolates joint-vs-factorized aggregation in this architecture, not all ways to use action-feedback information.
primary_comparison.controls: BATCH1,STOP,FULL_LOCAL reuse existing deterministic teacher-path traces. Old DIRECT and gamma0DQN all-seed families remain historical anchors; architecture/parameter count differs so do not call their comparison a pure representation ablation.
primary_comparison.no_shuffle: Use explicit factorized aggregation, not one chosen corruption permutation or a recoverable deterministic reward permutation.

target.continue_formula: (max(r_best,max new strictly admissible float32 rewards)-r_best - cost_per_query*next_queries)/gain_scale
target.scope: Original immediate teacher-path search value, not whole-week value or future-grid RL.

proposed_training.mode: supervised direct two-action value regression, not a new RL training run
proposed_training.optimizer: Adam lr0.0003 default original betas/epsilon, max_grad_norm10, CPU one thread.
proposed_training.loss: smooth_l1 beta1 mean over32x2 scalar targets, unchanged.
proposed_training.sampling: Exactly old train.npz probability; equal date, equal initial prefix within date, uniform reachable position. Match stored GRID107 index stream per seed.
proposed_training.endpoint: Final7250 only. No extra loss/budget/network/fee/seed variants, validation checkpoint selection or oversampling.
proposed_training.logging: Train-only fixed periodic loss checkpoints; validation only after all planned fits. Retain all3seeds.
proposed_training.timeout: Stop and preserve partial weights/error; no automatic cap extension or rerun complete fits.

evaluation.primary: Four-date macro COMPLETE saved search-trajectory net utility, all3seeds; not pooled one-step MSE.
evaluation.diagnostic: 108,552,RF-path552 always shown, never training oversampling or acceptance based only on552.
evaluation.mechanism_signal: JOINT family mean utility > FACTOR, all3 paired seed utility deltas>0, at least3/4 date deltas positive after seed averaging. Report mixed outcomes if not met; no significance claim from3seeds/4exposed dates.
evaluation.progression: Even if mechanism signal, competitive candidate additionally needs family mean utility above BATCH1 and BOTH historical DIRECT/gamma0DQN families. No automatic scale-up or physical rollout.
evaluation.uncertainty: No fitted predictive distribution this first round. Seeds describe optimization variability, not calibrated outcome uncertainty.
